operations.name: order
operations.description:
Create and submit new order for multiple services

Each item in the `items` array needs to include order `type` and parameters used
by one of the method listed below:

• `POST /certificate/order` - use `certificate` for item type

fields.name: ignore_errors
fields.description: Process order even if some of the items were rejected due to errors

operations.notes: The single entry point for placing an order. It accepts several items of any product type in one call — hosting, VPS, domains, SSL — so the per-product and per-domain order routes are not needed. Preview the price first with cart.quote, which takes the same payload and creates nothing.

operations.description:
Manage private/glue nameservers for a domain. Use the `action` parameter to select the operation:
- `registerNameServer` – register a new glue record (requires `nameserver` + `ip`)
- `modifyNameServer` – update the IP of an existing glue record (requires `nameserver` + `oldip` + `newip`)
- `deleteNameServer` – remove a glue record (requires `nameserver`)
